header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner, nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2016 with the prayer that respondents be directed to construct road advertised in N.I.T of 2016. Learned A.A.G submits that said scheme has now been completed, therefore, this petition has become infructuous, hence same is hereby disposed of. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
